title: I know there’s a lot of hate around AI, but it solved a problem for me last night that otherwise would have sucked
author: wewerecreaturres
selftext:
I play Enshrouded with a dedicated server and use exactly one mod. Yesterday the game updated and my server wouldn’t start because of the mismatch. I could have waited for the mod owner to update it, but people were commenting and the modder was nowhere to be found so I pointed Claude at the mod directory and 20 minutes later my server was back up and the mod worked flawlessly. 

Say what you will about the slop, but that’s not something I could have done myself and I’m glad there are tools that could solve the problem.

comments.author: Fizassist1
comments.body: this will fall on deaf ears of the anti.  glad you had the tools to fix your problem!

comments.author: berlingoqcc
comments.body: It's coding nobody will care that it's done via AI, it's relying on AI for creative inspiration in the game making process that people don't like....

replies.author: wewerecreaturres
replies.body: I do see a lot of people who just hate anything that used AI though
